description: React component for a single value selector with filtering, creation, and dropdown menu functionality, used in access control table editing within Mattermost.

methods.name: commitInputValue
methods.description: Handles committing the input value when editing or input loses focus.

methods.name: handleKeyDownSimpleInput
methods.description: Handles key down events for the simple input, commits on Enter.

methods.name: onFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter state based on user input.

methods.name: handleSelectItem
methods.description: Handles selection of an option from the dropdown.

methods.name: handleCreateValue
methods.description: Creates a new value if allowed and user input is valid.

methods.name: handleInputKeyDownForMenu
methods.description: Handles key events within the menu input, including creation on Enter.
